snippet.title: DC Anthology: Apocalypse Version 1.81 (10 Minutes Gameplay Video)
snippet.description: DC Anthology: Apocalypse is an updated version of DC Living: The Apocalypse. There's no audio in the video. This video is recorded on low-end Android phone (Snapdragon 425) so frame rate performance is not as smooth as compared to running the game without video recording.
